headline: Grimes' late three holds off Sacramento
dek: The Lakers trailed by 11 in the third quarter, went ahead on Quentin Grimes’ three with 56 seconds left and held on by 2.
three: Luka Dončić: 25 points and 8 assists in a 2-point win
9 of 18 from the floor, 5 of 6 at the line, 2 steals.
Lakers down 8 at the half, then won the second half 52–42
The Lakers’ bench outscored the Kings’ 34 to 5.
Won at the line and off the bench
Free throws made 17–9; bench points 34–5. L.A. made 17 free throws to Sacramento’s 9.
